name: Nanomech
abilities: Bio-electric energy blasts and explosive energy orbs from hands
Size reduction down to microscopic scale (cannot grow larger than a few inches)
Immunity to Nanochip Queen control (part human)
Adaptability - copied the Decoy Queen's tentacles
weaknesses: Tiny size - smooshed by a spellbook, swatted by a fly swatter
Useless against large opponents in a straight fight
Cannot grow beyond a few inches
summary: Ben's smallest alien, created when the Omnitrix scanned the alien Nanochips - a glowing microscopic bug that fights on the scale of circuitry.
traits: Created by scanning the Nanochip hive in Alien Swarm
Smaller than a human hand at full height
'Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee!'
Only alien with human DNA in the mix
notableFeats: Entered Victor Validus's brain and destroyed the Nanochip Decoy Queen, freeing everyone (Ben 10: Alien Swarm)
Disabled and defeated the Stalker from inside (Video Games)
Destroyed the headbands controlling Ra'ad and P'Andor (Ultimate Aggregor)
Blew up Incursean guns from inside (The Frogs of War: Part 1)
Defeated Mad Way Big (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Live-action movie render: grey insectoid body with green circuit-like markings, single large green eye, green wings, Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Animated version of the movie design: grey skin with green circuit pattern, one big green cyclopean eye, green wings, triangular feet; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

appearances.firstEpisode: Have I Got a Deal for You
notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2
appearances.designNotes: Circuit pattern removed, closer to the movie look; Omnitrix symbol replaces the single eye, surrounded by four small eyes; new wings and legs; body glows bright green.

scoring.rationale: A specialist for microscopic jobs - killed the Nanochip Queen from inside a brain and shut down the Stalker from within - but his blasts are small-scale and he can be flattened by a spellbook or fly swatter. Weak overall outside his niche.

notes: Alien Swarm is a live-action AF-era movie (Ben 16), so debut series is af with the AS render.
No homeworld: he is a hybrid created by the Omnitrix from Nanochip DNA plus Ben's human DNA.
